== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Advance Preparation (Japanese)|Advance Preparation]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67665 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(32, 9, 480, 624)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ab1c771027d5653f39e20515e59c389d00d9b32c1777504d93c16198e97c2ecb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
